_comment: Headed capture-session launch config. --start-maximized opens the OS window full-screen; viewport:null makes the render size follow the window (so recorded video shows the page as a real user sees it). playwright-cli's `resize` only sets the VIEWPORT, not the window frame — the window must be launched maximized, which is what this does. Applied ONLY on headed launches (see adapter openFlags); headless keeps a fixed viewport.
